question.problem: The first term of a geometric sequence is $2$, and the common ratio is $3.$ What is the $9$th term?
question.worked_solution:
The first term is $a_1=2,$ and the common ratio is $r=3,$ so we can write the formula for the $n$th term of the sequence:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}\cdot {r}^{n-1} \\  & =2\cdot {3}^{n-1}\end{aligned}
$$

To find the $9$th term, we can use this formula with $n={\color{blue}9}\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & =2\cdot {3}^{n-1} \\ {a}_{9} & =2\cdot {3}^{9-1} \\  & =2\cdot {3}^{8} \\  & =2\cdot 6561 \\  & =13\,122\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the $9$th term is $a_{9}=13\,122.$
